pageTitle: 2026 Week 2 Final: Oak Ridge at Klein Cain
metaTitle: Final: Klein Cain 45, Oak Ridge 20 | Cain Game Day
metaDescription: Final score and game report for Klein Cain’s 45–20 win over Oak Ridge.
socialDescription: Final score, players to know and recruiting notes from Klein Cain’s Week 2 win.

preview.playersNote: Player portraits: MaxPreps and public athlete profiles.

players.name: Earl O’Guinn Jr.
players.copy: The clearest breakaway threat in this game. O’Guinn averaged 50.5 rushing yards per game as a sophomore and is the only current Hurricane listed in the Rivals prospect database.

players.name: Cooper Karns
players.copy: Karns returns after five receiving touchdowns and nearly 72 yards per game last fall. If Oak Ridge crowds the box, he is the player most likely to make it pay.

players.name: Christian Redeo
players.copy: A steady tackler from the secondary. That matters after Cain allowed 41 in the opener and faces an Oak Ridge offense that needs explosive plays to keep pace.

players.name: Finn Walker
players.copy: Walker is the headliner at 6-foot-7 and 260 pounds. He is committed to Kansas State, and Rivals lists offers from Oklahoma State, Baylor, Arkansas and Syracuse. Cain has to know where No. 88 is on every passing down.

players.name: Elijah Berton
players.copy: Berton gives the War Eagles a second edge body with recruiting visibility. No public star rating was listed as of game day, so the size and role are the useful tells.

players.name: Cody Cooksey
players.copy: The listed junior running back is a natural pressure point in a game where Oak Ridge will want to keep Cain’s offense off the field. Public recruiting services do not list a rating.

recruiting.heading: Recruiting notes
recruiting.note: Ratings and recruiting status change often. “Unrated” here means no public rating was found in the linked Rivals/On3 data on Sept. 4, not that a player has no college interest.

rows.name: Finn Walker
rows.note: Three-star defensive lineman · Kansas State commit · Rivals Industry No. 680 nationally, No. 77 at DL, No. 91 in Texas.

rows.name: Earl O’Guinn Jr.
rows.note: Three-star 2028 running back · Rivals Industry No. 726 nationally, No. 56 at RB, No. 91 in Texas. SMU has made contact; LSU is also listed.

items.title: Find No. 88
items.body: Finn Walker’s length can wreck a slow-developing pass game. Chip him, move the launch point and make Oak Ridge find pressure somewhere else.

items.title: Make the first stop
items.body: Cain scored 42 last week and still needed every point. One early three-and-out changes the night from a race into a game Cain can dictate.

items.title: Get O’Guinn into space
items.body: Runs, screens, quick motion: the delivery method matters less than giving Cain’s young playmaker a clean edge and one defender to beat.

final.headline: Klein Cain beats Oak Ridge, 45–20
final.byline: Cain Game Day desk · Updated 11:20 PM CT
final.body: Klein Cain followed its one-point opener at Humble with a 25-point win over Oak Ridge. The Hurricanes are 2–0 heading into an open week before the Sept. 18 district opener against Tomball.

notes.heading: The prediction was close
paragraphs: Massey projected Klein Cain to win 44–20. The Hurricanes won 45–20, one point from the projected score.
Klein Cain improved to 2–0 and allowed 21 fewer points than it did in the 42–41 opener against Humble.
